items.title: John Ternus's first day as Apple CEO, JOLTS data, Dell earnings: What to Watch

items.title: What Tim Cook told employees on his last day at Apple

items.title: Apple outlines Ternus, Cook compensation in CEO transition
items.summary: Investing.com -- Apple has set John Ternus’ annual salary at $3 million as he takes over as chief executive, while the company outlined a new compensation structure for both Ternus and longtime CEO Tim Cook in a regulatory filing on Tuesday.
